in_sanskrit.name: Hamant
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Monkey God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hamant एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Hanuman, the Monkey God, is a central figure in Hindu mythology. He is known for his immense strength, loyalty, and devotion to Lord Rama. Hamant is believed to be derived from Hanuman.
